files.speaker: vale
files.text: A road to the record. Not a claim that we carried everything.

files.speaker: tor
files.text: Dry tools underneath. Sleeping cloths on top. Nobody should have to unpack a whole cart to lie down.

files.speaker: rook
files.text: I would prefer a lighter future. This one has cooking pots.

files.speaker: kael
files.text: What stays?

files.speaker: tor
files.text: The walls. What we cannot carry. The people who freely chose another road know where we are going.

files.speaker: rook
files.text: The pots have arrived. Tomorrow somebody still has to cook.

files.speaker: nera
files.text: The refuge has beds. It has no oath around it. We keep watch with people now.

files.speaker: kael
files.text: Can the road remain open behind us?

files.speaker: nera
files.text: While we maintain it. Whoever comes later deserves to know both where it goes and what it costs.

files.speaker: kael
files.text: And the Hart?

files.speaker: nera
files.text: We chose to leave its shelter and its full account. Keep the copies dry. Do not call them the whole of what we lost.

files.speaker: nessa
files.text: Count the portions, not the mouths into debts. A person can eat here and still disagree with us afterward.

files.speaker: elna
files.text: People keep bringing me empty bowls as if I can fill them with a speech. Give me a table that stays upright. I can begin there.

files.speaker: toma
files.text: A common fire saves wood. Carrying shares home saves arguments. I can tell you what either costs; I cannot tell every household which cost to bear.

files.speaker: tor
files.text: A beam can look straight and still have a rotten seat. Hold it while I check the bearing. We are building for the cart after ours, too.

files.speaker: rook
files.text: The water is slow here until the mill lets a pulse through. Read the wet marks on both banks before you promise anyone a quick crossing.

files.speaker: nera
files.text: Mark where a load can wait safely. A route is not open just because someone brave enough can get through it.

files.speaker: anwen
files.text: A bed should not become another confessional. Let the person sleep first. If they want to tell us anything tomorrow, tomorrow has room for it.

files.speaker: mira
files.text: Keep the dressings where a stranger can find them. If only I know where they are, we have built a room that stops working whenever I am tired.

files.speaker: vale
files.text: These are two different shelves. The public account belongs where anyone can compare it. A private statement stays sealed under its owner's terms. Do not let the shelves teach us to forget the difference.

files.speaker: merrow
files.text: I used to call an empty column an administrative problem. Sometimes it means no one agreed to do the work. That is a fact the book must preserve.

files.speaker: nessa
files.text: If the rota has a gap, put the gap on the board. Hiding it only means the same tired person fills it again.

files.speaker: nera
files.text: A handover needs an answer from the next pair of hands. Leaving a bundle beside someone is not the same thing.

files.speaker: rook
files.text: I have spent half my life learning which doors want payment before they open. Leave this one easy to find from the road.

files.speaker: tor
files.text: These bunks come apart with common pegs. A room that cannot be repaired by the people using it is only waiting to close.
